English: Amber Gathering Stand
A humble, makeshift stand of driftwood and hides where nomads gather raw Baltic amber from the shore, marking the first step in amber trade.
Sorting Hut
A primitive hut of brush and turf where workers sort and grade amber pieces, increasing efficiency and yield.
Polishing Bench
A sturdy wooden bench under a hide awning where skilled hands polish amber, making it ready for trade and craftsmanship.
Bead Stringers Tent
A large felt tent where artisans shape and string amber beads, attracting traders and increasing population.
Amber Carvers Pavilion
A robust pavilion with wooden supports and felt walls, housing skilled carvers and basic workshops for crafting ornamental amber goods.
Jewelry Hut
A well-built hut of planks and stone, hosting renowned artisans who shape Baltic amber into precious jewelry, drawing merchants from afar.
Traders Hall
A grand timber hall at the center of the camp, where amber traders and caravan leaders gather, boosting local commerce and supply.
Merchant Pavilion
A grand multi-tent complex with raised platforms, where wealthy merchants from distant lands convene to negotiate amber deals, enhancing clan prosperity and unity.
Amber Guildhouse
A fortified wooden guildhouse with storerooms, scriptoriums, and official weighing chambers, marking the rise of the Baltic amber trade as a major clan enterprise.
Baltic Amber Guild
A legendary institution: vast timbered halls, secure vaults, and bustling markets, governing the entire flow of Baltic amber and drawing caravans from every horizon.
